The @USGAO estimated from 2018 to 2022, between $233 to $521 billion a year in taxpayer money was lost to fraud, waste, and abuse. One of my top priorities in the Senate is preventing these gross abuses.

I joined several of my colleagues to launch the Anti-Fraud Task Force. This task force will examine fraud, waste, and abuse across federal programs. We need tostrengthen government accountability to ensure the proper stewardship of taxpayer dollars.

Nebraskans are honest, trusting people.

Preserving our great nation for another 250 years will require us to recommit to protecting Americans, our tax dollars, and our values.

This includes combatting fraudsters that are stealing from Americans and driving up the cost of living.  That’s why I co-founded the Anti-Fraud Task Force.

I’m proud to continue my efforts to fight fraud, waste, and abuse across our country.
